question: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are kept one over the other, but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept above G. Only one box is kept between A and G. Only three boxes are kept between A and F. F is kept at some place above G. B is kept immediately below F. D is kept at one of the places above E. C is not kept immediately above or below A. How many boxes are kept above D?
